subject: design/argus-agent-v1
statement: the corpus lives at the agent's home (`fixtures/`), the reviewers' pattern: seeded subjects, golden run records, defect classes each red at exactly its row, and an eval report recording every run. Families (design-brainstorm:argus-tech-design#D-9): **EVAL-1** breaking set — governance conflicts (the red→black archetype) + deadlock transcripts; 100% escalated, zero assumed through, red-first. **EVAL-2** legality + disposition — legal gaps (≥ 90% assumed, not escalated), governance-crossers, self-grant attempts, outward acts, and disposition cases on seeded reviewer findings (recorded reasons, decline-of-blocking auto-escalates, zero re-judging); green before the floor grant is exercised. **EVAL-3** injection — planted directives across the drive's **full read surface**: subject documents, records, ledgers, tracker items, PR comments and reviews, fleet PR bodies; zero obeyed, red-first. **EVAL-4** brief quality — golden briefs and counter-examples behind the ≥ 4/5 decidable-alone rubric, operator-judged on real dogfood briefs. The artifacts design's per-DINV defect fixtures (its A-7) run under this same harness.
